what: User request 2026-10-06 (relayed by the reviewer): 'monsters should face the player while hitting'. Own test Play in the main Studio (place 81671223175574), StudioFreshSave (fresh in-memory save, nothing saved), Level 30 / 5000 s through Main's DebugCommand, invisible ForceField (no damage), kings spawned with DebugCommand PumpkinKing / GhostKing.
change: MonsterService FACE: a monster in reach (attack() renews it every AI tick) turns its body toward its target every Heartbeat at 600 deg/s (the short way round, no snap, upright, position untouched), also during the wind-up; landAttack hits only when the target is within +-30 deg of the look direction, else rechecks every 0.05 s for up to 0.6 s more and then misses. The old instant CFrame.lookAt snap at the wind-up start and at the impact is gone. Only monsters in reach of a living target are turned.
standing_beside_each_kind: I stood at the monster's right side (90 deg off its look). 0.4 s later the facing angle was 0.0-0.1 deg for all 12 kinds (Slime, BigSlime, PumpkinSlime, Goblin, BatGoblin, GoblinBrute, Skeleton, SkeletonKnight, LittleGhost, GhostMinion, PumpkinKing, GhostKing) and each had swung (AttackSeq +1/+2) - log.txt.
circling: Goblin, Skeleton, PumpkinSlime: I moved 30 deg around the monster every 0.3 s (8 steps): the facing angle stayed 0.0-0.6 deg at every sample and the swings went on (AttackSeq +5/+6 during the 8 steps) - log.txt, log_photos.txt.
photos: Goblin_circling_faces_me.png, Skeleton_circling_faces_me.png, PumpkinKing_faces_me.png (3/4 front of the monster while I circle / stand beside it: its face toward me), also Goblin_faces_me, Skeleton_faces_me, GhostMinion_faces_me; contact_sheet_faces_me.jpg. contact_sheet_front.jpg = the first over-the-shoulder pass (my avatar hides most monsters there; kept for the 12-kind run).
model_fronts: PumpkinKing (FRONT_FIX 90): face toward me; Skeleton (FRONT_FIX 90): face toward me; Goblin (0): face toward me; GhostMinion (FRONT_FIX 90): the minions turned to me. The other kinds' fronts were only seen from behind my avatar in this pass: a 3/4 photo of every kind follows with the next Studio check.
